name: Floating Archive of Lost Whispers
description: A floating library of glass books, each holding captured whispers of forgotten memories, drifting among fluffy clouds.
prompt: A breathtaking floating archive composed of translucent glass books, each glowing with captured whispers, suspended in a sea of soft cumulus clouds, sunlit from below, whimsical, highly detailed, no text, ethereal atmosphere.
caption: Discover the stories that once drifted away – the Floating Archive holds whispers of a forgotten past.
